title: Not for kitchen tasks!
text: Not for kitchen tasks!. These aren't scissors like I expected at all. I was replacing a pair of Pampered Chef and unfortunately didn't come close. Tried them first on trimming chicken, just would t work, so thought maybe they Were better suited to cut the stems off the bottoms of fresh flowers they would not cut through them as my others had done for years. Disappointed, looking for another......great for cutting paper!
